title: Runtime Trace Probe Harness Catalog
canonical_rule: Librarium remains canonical; trace output is observed evidence only until reconciled.

probes.name: Scheduler Cadence Probe
probes.question: How often does the host worker loop invoke module-visible processing under idle and busy conditions?
probes.promotion_note: May promote scheduler cadence only after repeated observed traces match expected ordering and cadence. Does not promote gameplay formulas.

probes.name: Callback Registration Probe
probes.question: Which callbacks does MajorMUD register and which host services invoke them?
probes.promotion_note: Can promote callback usage from Hypothesis to Observed when actual module registration traces exist.

probes.name: Timed Callback Ordering Probe
probes.question: What is the observed order among RTKICK, RTIHDLR, SYSCYC, polling callbacks, and session status handlers?
probes.promotion_note: Can promote ordering behavior only when enough observed runs show stable order under load and idle.

probes.name: Output Flush Ordering Probe
probes.question: When is player-visible output enqueued, drained, and flushed relative to gameplay state updates?
probes.promotion_note: Can promote output ordering to Observed/Verified timing behavior only after trace + classic session corroboration.

probes.name: World Iteration Probe
probes.question: Does the world process sessions, rooms, NPCs, timers, combat, regen, and quest updates in a stable order?
probes.promotion_note: Observed world order is required before formula timing can be promoted.
